import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    acct_txn = inputs["acct_txn"].copy()
    
    # WHERE amount > 100
    acct_txn = acct_txn[acct_txn["amount"] > 100]
    
    # Add size_band column based on CASE logic
    # CASE WHEN amount >= 1000 THEN 'JUMBO'
    #      WHEN amount >= 500  THEN 'LARGE'
    #      ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    acct_txn["size_band"] = "STANDARD"
    acct_txn.loc[acct_txn["amount"] >= 500, "size_band"] = "LARGE"
    acct_txn.loc[acct_txn["amount"] >= 1000, "size_band"] = "JUMBO"
    
    # Apply ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_ts DESC, txn_id DESC)
    acct_txn = acct_txn.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_ts", "txn_id"],
        ascending=[True, False, False]
    )
    acct_txn["rn"] = acct_txn.groupby("account_id", sort=False).cumcount() + 1
    
    # QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() = 1
    result = acct_txn[acct_txn["rn"] == 1]
    
    # Select final columns in order
    result = result[["account_id", "txn_id", "txn_ts", "amount", "channel", "size_band"]]
    
    return {"latest_high_value_txn": result.reset_index(drop=True)}
